subject: Urgent request: extend pilot access while PO clears
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novocare.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request while PO processes

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood. We have a PO routed (expected to land by 06/24) but procurement is slower than we anticipated because of a vendor onboarding hold. Our engineers still need ~10 days of uninterrupted access to finish integration verification.

Could Redwood grant a short extension or temporary credit to keep our pilot environment live through the PO clearance? Ideally +14 days or an equivalent token allotment so our data-science lead can complete the end-to-end tests. If you need an internal contact for procurement, that would be me (copied).

Appreciate any help — we want to avoid a gap that would slow our rollout.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Director of ML Engineering, NovoCare
emily.zhang@novocare.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

[Attachment: purchase-overview.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novocare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request while PO processes

Emily — thanks for the context and the timeline. We can usually support short runway requests while a PO is in-flight. Two quick asks so I can expedite approval: 

- Please confirm the desired window (14 days vs 30 days) and an estimate of monthly token consumption during the extension.
- Confirm the HubSpot deal id (if you have it) or the PO number so we can tie the authorization to the account and avoid duplicate credits.

I’ve looped Marissa so she can approve the extension and Ben in finance can process crediting if needed (I’ll follow up internally now).

If you confirm 14 days and estimate ~50k tokens, I’ll request a temporary top-up and send you an authorization once approved.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Request: approve 14-day pilot extension for NovoCare (ND-8421)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Emily's note below. NovoCare (deal ND-8421) has a PO in routing but procurement expects a delay until ~06/24. They asked for a short runway to finish integration validation.

Ask: approve a 14-day extension starting 2027-06-18 (or equivalent 50k token temporary credit) tied to deal ND-8421. They estimate ~50k tokens for the two weeks given interactive testing and embedding workloads.

Why: This is a high-probability close (healthcare vertical, evaluating for a pilot-to-paid conversion). A gap risks losing momentum; the engineering team is mid-integration and has an internal go/no-go planned for 06/28.

If you approve, Ben — can you please: 
- Create a one-off credit line in the internal credits console (reason: "procurement delay, ND-8421, 14d pilot runway");
- Attach authorization to the HubSpot deal and notify CS and the account owner;
- Let me know when the credit is active so I can confirm with Emily.

I attached a short request doc summarizing the ask and usage estimate.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for a quick decision.

Priyom
[Attachment: Trial_TopUp_Request.pdf (form stub)]

Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novocare.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approve 14-day pilot extension for NovoCare (ND-8421)

Thanks for the clear ask, Priyom — approved.

Decision: Grant a 14-calendar-day extension (or 50,000 token credit) tied to deal ND-8421. Please tag the credit with the reason: "PO clearance delay - NovoCare ND-8421".

Ben — please proceed with the credit issuance and attach the approval PDF to the HubSpot deal. EMILY: once Ben confirms, this credit will be active and you should see the additional tokens applied to the pilot project within 1 hour. If you need the access window to start earlier, let us know — we can backdate by up to 48 hours in special cases.

I've attached the approval authorization for records. Priyom — please confirm with Emily once the credit posts and update the deal stage to "crediting approved".

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Attachment: trial-extension-authorization.pdf (signed approval stub)]
